logline: 시계처럼 사는 신사가 클럽에서 내기 하나를 걸고, 그날 저녁 짐도 없이 기차에 오른다.
destination: 런던 클럽의 문 — 여든 날째 저녁 그가 돌아와야 하는 자리
protagonist: 하루 일과를 분 단위로 지키는 런던 신사
setting: 1872년 런던 클럽과 인도·중국·태평양을 잇는 기차와 배
anchor: a composed gentleman in a grey frock coat with trimmed side whiskers holding a pocket watch, Victorian travel
palette: London soot grey, brass and steam white, tropical green, lamp gold

beats.visual: a gentleman opening a pocket watch beside a club fireplace, other members in deep leather chairs
beats.motion: the watch lid springs open, firelight jumps, a newspaper lowers across the room

beats.beat: 그는 여든 날이면 충분하다고 잘라 말한다.
beats.visual: a gentleman standing at a card table facing seated men, one hand flat on the green baize
beats.motion: his palm presses the baize, chairs push back, cigar smoke swirls up

beats.beat: 그날 저녁 그가 짐도 없이 기차에 오른다.
beats.visual: a gentleman stepping onto a station platform into a steam-wreathed carriage, no luggage in hand
beats.motion: steam billows across the platform, the carriage door swings, a whistle blast shakes the air

beats.beat: 인도의 철길이 밀림 한가운데서 끊겨 있다.
beats.visual: a railway line ending abruptly in dense jungle, passengers standing on the last sleepers
beats.motion: vines sway over the broken line, passengers mill about, birds burst from the canopy

beats.visual: an elephant carrying two men through thick jungle at dawn, mist between enormous trees
beats.motion: the elephant strides forward, branches sweep past, mist parts around it

beats.beat: 홍콩 부두에서 배가 이미 떠나 버린다.
beats.visual: a steamer pulling away from a crowded Hong Kong quay, a gentleman halted at the water's edge
beats.motion: the steamer slides out, hawsers splash into the water, crowds surge behind him

beats.beat: 그가 클럽 문을 여든 날째에 열 수 있을까?
beats.visual: a gentleman running up wide stone club steps at dusk, doorway lit above him
beats.motion: his feet pound the steps, the door swings ahead, gaslight flares along the street

beats.beat: 런던 클럽 난롯가에 빈 안락의자가 놓여 있다.
beats.visual: an empty leather club armchair beside a dying fire, a pocket watch left open on the side table
beats.motion: embers settle in the grate, the watch hand ticks, firelight dims

withheld: 동쪽으로 돌아 하루를 벌었다는 것과 내기의 승리
